alderreach_01.name: Brackenwell
alderreach_01.note: Wyla’s cottage, communal oven, orchard and departure.

events.title: Brace the northern milestone
events.text: The collar sits true. A silver signal answers from farther up the road.

alderreach_02.name: Glowing Road
alderreach_02.note: A winding orchard road; optional drainage tunnel and first save postbox.

alderreach_03.name: Stoneleigh Bridge
alderreach_03.note: Mara joins; damaged beam repair. Revisit for the Act V anchor.

events.title: Fit Mara’s bridge brace
events.text: Mara lifts the damaged span while you slide the timber into place. The crossing holds.

events.title: Repair the Stoneleigh relay
events.text: The repaired circuit holds and takes its share of the load.

alderreach_04.name: Thistledown
alderreach_04.note: Displaced hamlet: three relay clamps, six domestic interiors.

alderreach_05.name: Millbrook Mill
alderreach_05.note: Watermill, gear loft and sluice; break Corwin’s shell.

alderreach_06.name: Waystation
alderreach_06.note: Seven-founder mural and evidence of physical censorship.

events.title: Inspect the altered founders’ mural
events.text: The seventh figure was chiseled away. A surviving circuit diagram points toward Oakmere.

alderreach_07.name: Oakmere
alderreach_07.note: Walled market, clinic, armory and Iven’s recruitment.

alderreach_08.name: Alderreach Hearth
alderreach_08.note: Heat shutters and safety Warden; opens Veyra.

objects.name: Open the Orchard Coast Cache cache

events.title: Open the Orchard Coast Cache cache
events.text: You record the discovery in the road journal.

lanes.name: Open the Orchard Coast Cache cache

veyra_01.name: Marrowquay
veyra_01.note: Southern freshwater ferry hub; supplies and theater.

events.title: Clear the shore-side lock intake
events.text: Odalie reopens the freshwater ferry after the eel nest is cleared. Board at the north quay.

veyra_03.name: Marrow Sea
veyra_03.note: Freshwater inland basin, not the outer ocean.

veyra_04.name: North Lock
veyra_04.note: Ferry gate and travel branch to the northern mining road.

objects.name: Repair the North Lock towpath relay

events.title: Repair the North Lock towpath relay
events.text: The repaired circuit holds and takes its share of the load.

watercourses.name: North Lock canal
watercourses.outlet: Marrow Sea south of the gates

lanes.name: Repair the North Lock towpath relay

veyra_05.name: Drowned Capital
veyra_05.note: A submerged palace entered through drained lock chambers.

veyra_07.name: Veyra Hearth
veyra_07.note: Stabilize reversed current; unlock three-region pilgrimage.

events.title: Stabilize Veyra Hearth
events.text: The freshwater current returns to its channel. Kharad, Sereva and the Lantern Isles are open in any order.

events.title: Open the Reed Island cache
events.text: You record the discovery in the road journal.

veyra_10.name: Flood Relief Landing
veyra_10.note: Act IV evacuation and conduit deliveries.

kharad_02.name: Emberhold
kharad_02.note: Furnace city; ore, smithing and stoneborn contracts.

kharad_03.name: Buried Road
kharad_03.note: Support rooms and lift to Orrun’s regulator.

kharad_04.name: Deep Vault
kharad_04.note: Optional stone trial; Stone Elder and Grand Tome.

kharad_05.name: Kharad Hearth
kharad_05.note: Orange regulator shrine in basalt terraces.

events.text: The basalt regulators cool to an even orange. The Kharad Hearth Seal is secured.

events.title: Repair the basalt regulator
events.text: The repaired circuit holds and takes its share of the load.

kharad_06.name: Hardened Pass
kharad_06.note: Workers’ route; Act IV reinforcement quest.

kharad_07.name: Mineral Crown
kharad_07.note: A high ledge with fixed late-game treasure.

events.title: Open the Mineral Crown cache
events.text: You record the discovery in the road journal.

kharad_09.name: North Sluice Camp
kharad_09.note: Rest before the sealed Ordel border.

objects.name: Meet Tavi at the herd stop

events.text: Tavi shows the dry salt corridor and the irrigation crossing. The herd can guide you across the flats.

sereva_02.name: Salt Flats

sereva_03.name: Tallowback Sanctuary

sereva_07.note: Warm desert relay after restoring the root channel.

events.title: Open the Empty Reach cache
events.text: You record the discovery in the road journal.

watercourses.name: Well-Warden spring basin
watercourses.outlet: Stone-lined well or cistern; seep to the gardens

isles_02.note: Observatory settlement; Sella, books and public charts.

events.title: Repair the Isles beacon relay
events.text: The repaired circuit holds and takes its share of the load.

events.text: Auriel’s recording confirms the seventh beacon. The crew can now tune the Isles Hearth.

isles_09.name: Seventh Star Between
isles_09.note: Challenge unlock after Unwritten and Sixfold victories.

events.title: Resolve the Seventh Star encounter
events.text: Ysaudre’s recording ends and Caelan waits at the landing.

isles_10.name: Outer Skerries
isles_10.note: Optional reef islands and fixed caches.

events.title: Open the Outer Skerries cache
events.text: You record the discovery in the road journal.

objects.name: Assemble the Skiff at its mooring

lanes.name: Assemble the Skiff at its mooring

ordel_01.name: Pinefold
ordel_01.note: Wool, winter food and snow-road shelter.

ordel_03.name: Bell Cathedral

ordel_04.name: Winter Archive
ordel_04.note: Copies, exclusion orders and patient records.

objects.name: Repair the Ordel bell tower circuit

events.text: The repaired circuit holds and takes its share of the load.

lanes.name: Repair the Ordel bell tower circuit

ordel_08.name: Northwatch Ledge
ordel_08.note: Late landing and fixed growth cache.

events.text: You record the discovery in the road journal.

ordel_09.note: Delegates meet here after flood relief.

objects.name: Present the evidence to the Council

edrin_01.note: Wyla, Mother Ever, Kellan and living refugees; receive Edrin Seal.

events.text: Wyla and Mother Ever point out the fixed ledges through the Pale. The Seal opens Courier’s Gate.

edrin_02.name: Drifted Market
edrin_02.note: Tuck’s posted prices, normal recovery and rest.

edrin_03.name: Road of Echoes
edrin_03.note: Recorded refugee column; observation is optional.

edrin_04.name: Courier’s Gate
edrin_04.note: Seal opens the capital; no identity test.

edrin_05.name: Vesperholm
edrin_05.note: Gate Quay, Lamplight Market, courtyards and infirmary.

edrin_06.name: Ledger Hall
edrin_06.note: Ledger Wyrm and original Closure Oath.

edrin_07.name: Garden of Lamps

events.title: Light the east garden lamp

edrin_09.note: Echo, Caelan and Hollow Crown; all normal combat.

events.title: Resolve the north ward encounter
events.text: A ward-stone clears. Three stones reveal the Unwritten.

events.title: Resolve the east ward encounter
events.text: A ward-stone clears. Three stones reveal the Unwritten.

events.text: The Unwritten’s ward gives way. The Seventh Star also requires the Sixfold victory.

east_trade.name: Eastern Caravan Road
east_trade.note: A dry caravan staging road south of the Pale.

coast_terminal.name: South Coast Terminal
coast_terminal.note: Overland transfer from Marrowquay to the saltwater wharf.

hall_of_seven.name: Hall of Seven
hall_of_seven.note: The original vote and the new charter stand side by side.

lullaby_stairs.name: Lullaby Stairs
lullaby_stairs.note: A quiet ascent from the library to the final Hearth.

south_causeway.name: Restored South Causeway
south_causeway.note: The relays hold a continuous stone route from Vesperholm to Oakmere.

events.title: Collect the repaired mailbag
events.text: Wyla hands you the mailbag. Hob is waiting by the northern milestone.

events.title: Receive Tilda’s Waylantern
events.text: Wyla has taken the north road. Tilda gives you the Waylantern and points out the east orchard lane.

events.title: Resolve the barn Wickling encounter
events.text: The frightened Wickling scatters into harmless candlelets. Pell brings a letter sealed with the seventh crest.

drainage_tunnel.name: Orchard Drainage Tunnel
drainage_tunnel.note: Orchard Drainage Tunnel opens onto Glowing Road.

events.title: Release the pantry relay clamp
events.text: The clamp releases with a dull click. The pressure falls at the mill gate.

thistle_loom.name: Marta’s Loom House
thistle_loom.note: Marta’s Loom House opens onto Thistledown.

events.text: The clamp releases with a dull click. The pressure falls at the mill gate.

mill_sluice.note: Millbrook Sluice opens onto Millbrook Gear Loft.

events.title: Clear the tailrace

events.text: Corwin’s Pale shell breaks. Ellie leads him up to the loading floor. The road to the waystation is clear.

events.text: Iven joins you to investigate the lost pressure at the Hearth.

events.title: Resolve the siphon-root encounter
events.text: The siphon breaks and clear water returns to the root channel. Kellan’s marker points toward Stillfolk.

events.text: The assembly is secured for the Skiff rigging crew.

beacon_chamber.note: Skerrin Beacon Chamber opens onto Skerrin Light.

events.title: Recover the beacon coil
events.text: The assembly is secured for the Skiff rigging crew.

events.text: The seventh bell’s dismantling is documented. Follow Alisende to the Winter Archive.

events.text: Ottoline releases the Closure Oath and the original plans. The testimony explains why the center was sealed.

events.title: Charge the escape relay
events.text: The party survives Caelan’s assault and receives the Seventh Ember. Flood relief has begun at Veyra’s landing.

quiet_stacks.name: Quiet Library Rotunda

events.title: Align the library bridge
events.text: The rotating span meets the Lullaby Stairs landing.

seventh_chamber.note: Seventh Hearth Chamber opens onto Seventh Hearth.

events.title: Resolve the Seventh Hearth finale
events.text: The Hollow Crown falls. The seven relays share the load and the south causeway reconnects Oakmere to Vesperholm.

events.text: The new brace carries the load. The central lift will run when all three supports are shored.

events.title: Shore the east support
events.text: The new brace carries the load. The central lift will run when all three supports are shored.

events.title: Resolve Orrun’s regulator encounter
events.text: The mineral shell opens. Orrun survives, and Bram brings out the signed Closure Oath.

events.title: Stabilize Kharad Hearth
events.text: The basalt regulators cool to an even orange. The Kharad Hearth Seal is secured.

events.title: Meet Tavi at the herd stop
events.text: Tavi shows the dry salt corridor and the irrigation crossing. The herd can guide you across the flats.

events.title: Turn the west irrigation valve
events.text: Water enters the existing aqueduct toward the oasis. All three valves steady the forest crossing.

events.title: Turn the center irrigation valve
events.text: Water enters the existing aqueduct toward the oasis. All three valves steady the forest crossing.

events.title: Turn the east irrigation valve
events.text: Water enters the existing aqueduct toward the oasis. All three valves steady the forest crossing.

events.title: Resolve the siphon-root encounter
events.text: The siphon breaks and clear water returns to the root channel. Kellan’s marker points toward Stillfolk.

events.title: Stabilize Sereva Hearth
events.text: The relay warms as the restored channel carries water to the wells.

events.title: Read Sella’s corrected star chart
events.text: Sella joins you and marks three permanent Skiff assemblies at the vault, pirate cache and lighthouse.

events.title: Recover the clock-engine
events.text: The assembly is secured for the Skiff rigging crew.

events.title: Recover the star-glass lens
events.text: The assembly is secured for the Skiff rigging crew.

events.title: Recover the beacon coil
events.text: The assembly is secured for the Skiff rigging crew.

events.title: Assemble the Skiff at its mooring
events.text: The engine, lens and coil are fitted. The first charted flights reach the Between and Sky Sanctuary.

events.title: Resolve the Watcher Between encounter
events.text: Auriel’s recording confirms the seventh beacon. The crew can now tune the Isles Hearth.

events.title: Stabilize Isles Hearth
events.text: The beacons agree on a safe route. The Isles Hearth Seal is secured.

events.title: Resolve the Bell Mother encounter
events.text: The seventh bell’s dismantling is documented. Follow Alisende to the Winter Archive.

events.title: Copy the exclusion orders
events.text: Alisende stores copies at the archive and marks the maintenance descent behind the Cathedral.

events.title: Stabilize Ordel Hearth
events.text: The bell-engine steadies. Return to the cathedral’s maintenance road to escape toward the Pale.

events.title: Receive the Edrin Seal
events.text: Wyla and Mother Ever point out the fixed ledges through the Pale. The Seal opens Courier’s Gate.

events.title: Resolve the Ledger Wyrm encounter
events.text: Ottoline releases the Closure Oath and the original plans. The testimony explains why the center was sealed.

events.title: Charge the escape relay
events.text: The party survives Caelan’s assault and receives the Seventh Ember. Flood relief has begun at Veyra’s landing.

events.title: Guide the children to the relief quay
events.text: The ferry crew takes this group to higher ground.

events.title: Guide the apprentices to the relief quay
events.text: The ferry crew takes this group to higher ground.

events.title: Guide the household to the relief quay
events.text: The ferry crew takes this group to higher ground.

events.title: Secure the relief conduit
events.text: The Unmoored Hearth is stabilized. Relief boats unload at the drained steps. Delegates gather near Pinefold.

events.title: Present the evidence to the Council
events.text: The border squads open the approach to the Emergency Keeping. Return to Bell Cathedral.

events.title: Copy the bell-room records
events.text: Sella and Tavi preserve the orders that controlled the bells.

events.title: Disable the choir loft circuit
events.text: Iven and Bram isolate the reinforcement conduit. The cloister approach is safe.

events.title: Resolve the Emergency Keeping
events.text: Hesper surrenders the full relay plans. Six regional anchors can now be repaired in any order.

events.title: Repair the Stoneleigh relay
events.text: The repaired circuit holds and takes its share of the load.

events.title: Repair the North Lock towpath relay
events.text: The repaired circuit holds and takes its share of the load.

events.title: Repair the basalt regulator
events.text: The repaired circuit holds and takes its share of the load.

events.title: Repair the oasis well circuit
events.text: The repaired circuit holds and takes its share of the load.

events.title: Repair the Wrackport beacon lens
events.text: The repaired circuit holds and takes its share of the load.

events.title: Repair the Brightwatch chart beacon
events.text: The repaired circuit holds and takes its share of the load.

events.title: Repair the Skerrin beacon lens
events.text: The repaired circuit holds and takes its share of the load.

events.title: Repair the Isles beacon relay
events.text: The repaired circuit holds and takes its share of the load.

events.title: Repair the Ordel bell tower circuit
events.text: The repaired circuit holds and takes its share of the load.

events.title: Light the west garden lamp
events.text: The arcade brightens. The Hall of Seven opens when all three lamps are lit.

events.title: Light the center garden lamp
events.text: The arcade brightens. The Hall of Seven opens when all three lamps are lit.

events.title: Light the east garden lamp
events.text: The arcade brightens. The Hall of Seven opens when all three lamps are lit.

events.title: Align the library bridge
events.text: The rotating span meets the Lullaby Stairs landing.

events.title: Resolve the Seventh Hearth finale
events.text: The Hollow Crown falls. The seven relays share the load and the south causeway reconnects Oakmere to Vesperholm.

events.title: Resolve the west ward encounter
events.text: A ward-stone clears. Three stones reveal the Unwritten.

events.title: Resolve the north ward encounter
events.text: A ward-stone clears. Three stones reveal the Unwritten.

events.title: Resolve the east ward encounter
events.text: A ward-stone clears. Three stones reveal the Unwritten.

events.title: Resolve the Unwritten encounter
events.text: The Unwritten’s ward gives way. The Seventh Star also requires the Sixfold victory.

events.title: Resolve elemental trial 1
events.text: This portal rests. You can use the safe court between trials.

events.title: Resolve elemental trial 2
events.text: This portal rests. You can use the safe court between trials.

events.title: Resolve elemental trial 3
events.text: This portal rests. You can use the safe court between trials.

events.text: This portal rests. You can use the safe court between trials.

events.text: This portal rests. You can use the safe court between trials.

events.title: Resolve elemental trial 6
events.text: This portal rests. You can use the safe court between trials.

events.title: Resolve the Sixfold finale
events.text: The six trials are complete. The Seventh Star route now checks both recorded victories.

events.title: Resolve the Seventh Star encounter
events.text: Ysaudre’s recording ends and Caelan waits at the landing.

events.title: Open the Orchard Coast Cache cache
events.text: You record the discovery in the road journal.

events.title: Open the Reed Island cache
events.text: You record the discovery in the road journal.

events.title: Open the Mineral Crown cache

events.title: Open the Outer Skerries cache
events.text: You record the discovery in the road journal.

events.title: Open the Northwatch Ledge cache
events.text: You record the discovery in the road journal.

events.title: Clear the sanctuary spring channel
events.text: The spring feeds the cistern and ration jars again.

events.title: Seat the beacon’s replacement lens
events.text: The lamp sweeps the marked coastal lane.

events.title: Thaw the shelter alarm bell
events.text: The shelter bell now rings clearly above the pass.
